title: Sunday · Twelve
logline: The arc's Sunday, panels wider than the strip has ever drawn them: the alley, the dog at twelve walking slowly with the man matching him, the dumpster, the sign with its S dark. Three tiers, each the full width, each slow.

panels.composition: Tier 1: the alley at night, very wide, a man and an old dog walking slowly side by side, small at the left.

image.prompt: a very wide night alley in rain with a man and an old dog walking slowly side by side small at the left, watercolor, no words

panels.name: Slow

panels.composition: Tier 2: the same width, the two of them at the middle now, the dumpster ahead.

image.prompt: the same very wide rainy alley with the man and the old dog now at the middle and a dumpster ahead, watercolor, no words

panels.name: Middle

panels.composition: Tier 3: the same width, the two at the right under the sign, its S dark, the man's hand on the dog.

image.prompt: the same very wide alley with the man and the old dog at the right beneath a neon bowling sign with one letter dark, his hand on the dog's back, watercolor, no words

panels.name: Sign

art.palette: limited, muddy; Sundays in watercolor, improving

notes: The panels wider. S dark since 2010. Hand on the dog.
